pages.heading: Weather along the route
pages.body: Weather2 uses moving local weather. Rain in one area does not mean the whole world is in the same storm. Look at approaching clouds and wind before choosing a long crossing. Thunderstorms bring lightning. Snowstorms and sandstorms

pages.heading: Weather along the route +...
pages.body: reduce visibility and make movement harder. Tornadoes can move entities and damage allowed blocks. Check the weather even when the Wither Storm is far away.

pages.heading: KNCraft storm settings
pages.body: Severe storms are less frequent than in the supplied pack settings. The documented global cooldowns are three hours generally and ten hours for land-based spacing, measured in server ticks. They are not appointments for the

pages.heading: KNCraft storm settings +...
pages.body: next storm. Tornadoes do not aim at the nearest player when they spawn. They can still affect players, mobs and allowed wood or foliage blocks.

pages.heading: Prepare before arrival
pages.body: Choose a substantial shelter before visibility disappears. Keep away from exposed trees and loose wooden structures during severe weather. Bring animals inside and keep an exit route clear. A lightning rod can help manage local

pages.heading: Prepare before arrival +...
pages.body: lightning. Carry enough food and temperature supplies to wait rather than crossing open terrain in poor conditions. Repair damage only after the storm has moved away.

pages.heading: Monitoring and defense
pages.body: Wind Vanes and Anemometers help read wind. Sensor and Siren blocks support local warning setups. A Weather Deflector can protect an area from tornado effects; check its coverage in a local test before trusting a permanent build to it. Radar and

pages.heading: Monitoring and defense +...
pages.body: Forecast blocks have version limitations in 1.20.1. Do not depend on them as your warning system. They are omitted from the working-equipment examples here.

pages.heading: Know the difference
pages.body: Hail is represented by particles in this version; do not import every damage mechanic from old Weather2 videos. Fire tornadoes are available as spawned events, which does not establish that KNCraft naturally generates them. A Guster is an

pages.heading: Know the difference (cont.)
pages.body: Alex's Mobs creature with its own attacks and drops. It is not a small Weather2 tornado. Hurricane footage from other releases may also show behavior that differs from this pack.

pages.heading: A tornado nearby
pages.body: Airborne debris marks the tornado. Reach shelter before it reaches your route.

pages.heading: Snow and visibility
pages.body: Blowing snow hides landmarks. Wait under cover if you lose the route.

pages.heading: Storm overhead
pages.body: Dark storm clouds above the trees. Keep a sheltered route within reach.

pages.heading: A village siren
pages.body: The owner's village warning setup. A siren warns of danger; it is not shelter.

pages.heading: Weather to recognize
pages.body: SCREENSHOT NEEDED. Storm, tornado, snow and siren captures are included. Still needed: a Deflector setup showing its placement. No extra HUD capture is needed.
